sections.heading: Interfaces
sections.content: EachtyFlowis able to export “I_PARTICLEOBJ” and “I_VRAYGEOMETRY” interfaces to 3ds Max. In some cases, enabling these can cause issues betweentyFlowand other plugins. In other cases, you might want to limit which particles are sent back to a particle query request. These settings allow you to override these interface exports.

sections.heading: ParticleObject Interface
sections.content:
Enable Particle Interface: controls whether the particle interface will be returned when thetyFlowobject is queried for its default interface. Returning this interface allows third-party plugins to query atyFlowfor its particles.Incl. legacy interface: when enabled, 3ds Max’s legacy particle interface (I_PARTICLEOBJ) will be enabled, as well as its modern interface (IParticleObjectExt).

Enable Particle Interface: controls whether the particle interface will be returned when thetyFlowobject is queried for its default interface. Returning this interface allows third-party plugins to query atyFlowfor its particles.

Incl. legacy interface: when enabled, 3ds Max’s legacy particle interface (I_PARTICLEOBJ) will be enabled, as well as its modern interface (IParticleObjectExt).

Disabling the “incl. legacy interface” setting can improve compatibility with certain 3rd party plugins.

Export groups: controls which particle export groups will be returned when atyFlowis queried for its particles. Use these groups to limit which particles will be sent to third-party plugins querying atyFlowfor its I_PARTICLEOBJ interface.

For example, if you have a PhoenixFD grid which uses atyFlowas a PHXSource input object, you might only want to use certain particles in the flow to affect the PhoenixFD simulation. By limiting the particles exported through the I_PARTICLEOBJ interface (by setting the desired export groups), you can limit which particles will be returned to the PhoenixFD object.

When a 3rd party plugin asks tyFlow for the scale of a particle, these options let you choose what property of the particle is returned.

Return scale: the explicit scale value of the particle will be returned.Return shape diameter: the diameter of the particle’s shape mesh will be returned.

Return scale: the explicit scale value of the particle will be returned.

Return shape diameter: the diameter of the particle’s shape mesh will be returned.

sections.heading: Volume interface
sections.content:
Display volume interface preview: when enabled, data returned by thetyFlowvolume interface will be visualized in the viewport.Use debug volume: when enabled, a spherical density/color shape, contained within 64 individual volumes, will be displayed, rather than normal data passed through the interface. Developers can access this data by passing “debug” as their plugin name when using thetyFlowvolume interface.World-space samples: when enabled, the volumes will be visualized by sampling points within them in world space, rather than by iterating through the voxels of each volume directly. This method simulates a classic ray-march through the volume(s).Step size: controls the overall sampling step size.

Display volume interface preview: when enabled, data returned by thetyFlowvolume interface will be visualized in the viewport.

Use debug volume: when enabled, a spherical density/color shape, contained within 64 individual volumes, will be displayed, rather than normal data passed through the interface. Developers can access this data by passing “debug” as their plugin name when using thetyFlowvolume interface.

World-space samples: when enabled, the volumes will be visualized by sampling points within them in world space, rather than by iterating through the voxels of each volume directly. This method simulates a classic ray-march through the volume(s).

Step size: controls the overall sampling step size.

sections.heading: VRay Interface
sections.content:
Enable VRay Interface: controls whether the I_VRAYGEOMETRY interface will be returned when thetyFlowobject is queried by VRay for its VRay-compatible interface.

Disabling the VRay interface will preventtyFlowfrom being able to render VRay instances.
